entries.question: Vascular Surgery Centre, KGMU, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh appointment
entries.answer:

### **Appointment Booking Methods**
1.  **Online Portal (Recommended):** Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). 
    *   Select State: **Uttar Pradesh**
    *   Select Hospital: **King George's Medical University**
    *   Click 'New Appointment' and follow the steps to select the **Vascular Surgery** department.
2.  **Mobile App:** Download the **ABHA / Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store and follow the same booking flow as the ORS portal.
3.  **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS with the text `"APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]"` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in Registration:** You can register on-site at the KGMU OPD counters. 
    *   **Requirement:** You must bring the patient's **Aadhaar Card** and an active mobile number to receive the OTP for registration.
    *   **Important:** Please arrive early, as registration counters typically close at 1:00 PM.

*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of **₹50** for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please ensure you carry a valid referral letter for the department.

entries.question: How can I book an appointment online
entries.answer:

7.  **Patient Info:** Enter the patient's details (Aadhaar number is often required).
8.  **Payment:** Pay the ₹50 registration fee online.
9.  **Confirmation:** Download or print your appointment slip.

### **Method 2: Mobile App**
*   Download the **"ABHA"** or **"Health Care"** app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal mentioned above.

### **Method 3: SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format to **8887019134**:
    *   `APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]`
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

---

### **Important Information for Patients:**
*   **Registration Fee:** A flat fee of ₹50 is charged for the OPD slip.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please carry a valid referral letter for your specific department.

2. **मोबाइल ऐप:**
   - आप 'ABHA' या 'Health Care' ऐप डाउनलोड करके भी अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।

3. **SMS द्वारा:**
   - आप **8887019134** नंबर पर "APPOINTMENT [मरीज का नाम]" लिखकर SMS भेज सकते हैं।

4. **अस्पताल में पंजीकरण (Walk-in):**
   - आप सीधे ओपीडी (OPD) काउंटर पर भी जा सकते हैं। इसके लिए मरीज का **आधार कार्ड** और **सक्रिय मोबाइल नंबर** साथ होना अनिवार्य है। काउंटर पर ओटीपी (OTP) आने के बाद ही पर्ची (टोकन) बनेगी।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* **OPD का समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक)। रविवार को ओपीडी बंद रहती है।
* **पर्ची का शुल्क:** ₹50 (सभी बुकिंग माध्यमों के लिए)।

entries.question: How to book an appoimnent hemotplogy
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Department of Clinical Hematology at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that **online pre-booking is strongly recommended** to avoid long wait times.

### Booking Methods:

1.  **Online Portal (ORS):**
    *   Visit [www.ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in).
    *   Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital.
    *   Click on "New Appointment," choose the **Clinical Hematology** department, select your preferred date, and follow the steps to complete the ₹50 payment.

2.  **Mobile App:**
    *   Download the **ABHA / Health Care App** from the KGMU Play Store.
    *   Register with your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal to book your slot.

3.  **SMS Booking:**
    *   Send an SMS in the format: `"APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>"` to **8887019134**. You will receive a confirmation for your booking.

4.  **Walk-in (On-Site):**
    *   You can visit the hospital in person. You must carry the patient's **Aadhaar card** and a mobile phone to receive an OTP for registration.
    *   Proceed to the registration counter to pay the ₹50 fee and collect your physical OPD slip.

**Important Reminders:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM).
*   **Registration:** The ticket counters close at 1:00 PM sharp, so please arrive early.
*   **Medical Advice:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. If you are experiencing symptoms, please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD.
*   **Safety:** Please do not share personal health details, Aadhaar numbers, or phone numbers in this chat for your own safety.

For any further assistance, you can call the KGMU help desk at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: हर्निया के ऑपरेशन का क्या खर्चा आता है
entries.answer:
हर्निया के ऑपरेशन का खर्च कई कारकों पर निर्भर करता है, जैसे कि सर्जरी का प्रकार (लेप्रोस्कोपिक या ओपन), उपयोग की जाने वाली जाली (Mesh) का प्रकार, और अस्पताल में रहने की अवधि।

KGMU के आधिकारिक रेट लिस्ट के अनुसार, हर्निया सर्जरी से जुड़ी अनुमानित लागत ₹300 से ₹4,000 के बीच हो सकती है, लेकिन यह केवल एक आधारभूत (Base) शुल्क है। इसमें एनेस्थीसिया, दवाएं, जांच और अस्पताल में भर्ती होने का शुल्क अलग से जुड़ सकता है।

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
1. **सटीक जानकारी:** सर्जरी का वास्तविक खर्च आपकी स्थिति की गंभीरता और डॉक्टर द्वारा सुझाई गई प्रक्रिया पर निर्भर करेगा। कृपया संबंधित **सर्जरी विभाग (Surgery Department)** में जाकर डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।
2. **रेट लिस्ट:** आप विस्तृत जानकारी के लिए KGMU की आधिकारिक रेट लिस्ट यहाँ देख सकते हैं: [https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm)
3. **परामर्श:** डॉक्टर से मिलने के लिए आपको OPD पर्ची बनवानी होगी। आप [www.ors.gov.in](http://www.ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।

मैं एक एआई हूँ और चिकित्सा संबंधी निर्णय लेने या सटीक खर्च बताने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। कृपया उचित सलाह के लिए सीधे KGMU के सर्जरी विभाग के ओपीडी काउंटर पर संपर्क करें। 

*कृपया ध्यान दें: अपनी व्यक्तिगत स्वास्थ्य जानकारी, आधार नंबर या फोन नंबर इस चैट में साझा न करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए केवल आधिकारिक पोर्टल का ही उपयोग करें।*

To get accurate information regarding the bond amount for the B.Sc. Nursing program at King George's Medical University, please refer to the official admissions page on our website: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

The bond requirements and amounts can vary based on the specific academic year and government regulations. You may also find the relevant details in the official information brochure for the current academic session posted on that page. 

If you cannot find the specific amount there, I recommend contacting the Registrar's Office at **0522-2253171** for the most up-to-date information.

entries.question: Where we will find joining letter
entries.answer:
To find your joining letter or official recruitment-related correspondence from King George's Medical University (KGMU), please follow these steps:

1.  **Official Website:** Regularly check the **[KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)**. Important communications regarding recruitment, merit lists, and joining instructions are uploaded there.
2.  **Recruitment Portal:** If you applied through a specific recruitment portal (often linked via the main website at [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)), log in to your candidate dashboard using your registered credentials.
3.  **Registered Email/SMS:** Ensure you check the email address and mobile number you provided during the application process. Official appointment or joining letters are typically sent directly to the candidate's registered email.
4.  **Administrative Contact:** If you have been notified of your selection and are waiting for the specific joining letter, you may contact the **Registrar Office** for status updates.
    *   **Registrar Office Phone:** 0522-2253171
    *   **IP Phone Directory:** You can also check [https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php](https://kgmu.org/ipphonedirctory.php) to find the direct extension for the recruitment or establishment section.

Please monitor the official website closely, as this is the primary source for all authentic information.
